title: Update onboarding to the new 4-screen flow
text:
## Summary

Priya Raman's onboarding redesign is approved. The flow goes from 7 screens down to 4:

1. Welcome screen with a short video of a study group in action
2. Pick your university and courses
3. Set your free time with the weekly grid
4. Choose a study style (quiet, discussion, or exam cram)

The old "about you" screen is removed, because 4 of the 12 beta testers almost quit there. The profile photo is now requested after the first group session.

## Tasks

- [ ] Build the 4 new screens
- [ ] Apply the final brand colors (teal `#0F766E`, coral `#F97362`)
- [ ] Ask for the notification permission on screen 4 (see the Android 15 bug)
- [ ] Remove the old "about you" screen

Design details: "Onboarding redesign" page in Notion. Due before the Oct 25 store submission.
